name: kxaaagasw
title: Will the AAA US average regular gas price be above $4.56 on Oct 19, 2026?
settlement: If average regular gas prices for the United States are strictly greater than $4.5600 on Oct 19, 2026 according to AAA, the market resolves to Yes. Other strikes in the series (Above 4.4600 to 4.5600 and beyond) resolve the same way at their own thresholds.
decideContext: Estimate the effect of the news item on the AAA national average price of regular unleaded gasoline, in USD per gallon, as posted for Oct 19, 2026. The market resolves Yes if that AAA figure is strictly above the strike, with strikes spaced $0.02 apart around $4.46-$4.56.
